import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 75000.0]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nSerialized to {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from the binary data
buffer.seek(0)  # Reset buffer position
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Confirm the round trip
assert df.frame_equal(df_restored), "DataFrames do not match!"
print("\n✓ Round trip successful - DataFrames match!")
